overview_description.description: PayCaddy enables Latam companies to launch financial products with an API based platform. Rather than building fintech from scratch, or dealing with a legacy bank, companies can use PayCaddy to open digital wallets with KYC checks, process online payments, and issue personalized debit and prepaid cards for customers or employees.
